extraction.rule: block lines 21-133 read at the record pin; a numeral token is a maximal digit run with internal '.' or ',' groups (regex \d+(?:[.,]\d+)*|\.\d+) or a number word (zero..twelve, half; case-insensitive, word-bounded).
